components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepts spaces, dashes and
            brackets and an optional leading '+' with country code on input; stored and
            returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits). A number without a
            country code is assumed to be '+61' with a single leading '0' dropped.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[+()0-9 -]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be four
            digits and, for a city with a known region (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
            Brisbane->QLD), fall inside that region's inclusive range (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit
            postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form.
            Optional on create; when omitted the server sets it to the current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form. Optional; when
            present the server derives the owner's 'ageBand' from it.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Create-only flag. When true, the owner may share a last name and
            address with an existing owner (the household-duplicate rule is bypassed).
            Not persisted and never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepts spaces, dashes and
            brackets and an optional leading '+' with country code on input; stored and
            returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits). A number without a
            country code is assumed to be '+61' with a single leading '0' dropped.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[+()0-9 -]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be four
            digits and, for a city with a known region (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
            Brisbane->QLD), fall inside that region's inclusive range (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit
            postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form.
            Optional on create; when omitted the server sets it to the current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form. Optional; when
            present the server derives the owner's 'ageBand' from it.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Create-only flag. When true, the owner may share a last name and
            address with an existing owner (the household-duplicate rule is bypassed).
            Not persisted and never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>'
                where CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the city, LAST3 the
                upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN a per-city 4-digit
                zero-padded sequence (one more than the owners already in that city).
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                owner's customerCode (non-digit separators are ignored).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable shared identifier for owners in the same household
                (same last name and address). Assigned when an owner is created with
                'sharesHousehold' true; null otherwise.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F60718'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first
                name and last name (compared case-insensitively) at the moment it was
                created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, from 1 to 3, computed at
                creation. Starts at 1; adds 1 when an email is present; adds 1 when
                namesakeCount is 0; capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region derived from the owner's city using the
                fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk sign-up warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this
                owner's registration date at the moment it was created (a high-volume
                sign-up day); false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from their
                fields; 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band, derived from 'birthDate' measured against
                'registrationDate'; 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64 and
                'SENIOR' from 65. Null when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The single derived key all duplicate detection is expressed
                through, formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (email and
                householdId are empty when absent). A create is rejected 409 only when a
                new owner's whole identityKey equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F60718'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## Summary

I implemented the soft-match "possible duplicate" rule for `POST /api/owners`. A new owner that clears the hard-duplicate check but shares an existing owner's **lastName + postcode** with a **different telephone** is still created, and now carries `possibleDuplicate: true` with `possibleDuplicateOf` set to the matching owner's id (earliest match if several); otherwise `possibleDuplicate: false`.

Changes:

1. **`model/Owner.java`** — added persisted `possibleDuplicate` (Boolean) and `possibleDuplicateOf` (Integer) fields with getters/setters.

2. **`rest/function/owner/FlagPossibleDuplicate.java`** (new) — the pipeline step. It runs on the built owner, defaults both fields to false/null, then scans existing owners for a same-lastName (case-insensitive) + same-postcode match with a differing telephone, and flags it. A new owner without a postcode never soft-matches.

3. **`officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml`** — inserted `flagPossibleDuplicate` between `flagBulkSignup` and `save`, under the write transaction.

4. **`resources/openapi.yml`** — added `possibleDuplicate` / `possibleDuplicateOf` to the `Owner` response schema so they surface in the generated `OwnerDto` (MapStruct maps them by name automatically; no mapper change needed).

5. **DB schemas** (`hsqldb`, `h2`, `mysql`, `postgres`) — added the two columns; updated the positional `INSERT INTO owners VALUES` rows in `hsqldb/data.sql` (the DB the tests use) to match the new column count. h2/postgres inserts use explicit column lists and were unaffected; mysql has no owner seed inserts.

Test result: `AcceptanceTest` (the soft-match checkpoint) and the full suite are green — `Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0` / `BUILD SUCCESS`.
